objective: Validate the external exact-verifier worker and supervisor with synthetic systems and controlled process outcomes. No FEM assembly, harmonic solve, or archived NAFEMS frequency is included.

cases_and_expected_results.normal: A synthetic represented system with zero exact residual remains exact_status PASS after supervised execution; a system with relative residual 1 remains exact_status FAIL.
cases_and_expected_results.worker_exception: A malformed NPZ is recorded as supervisor_status WORKER_EXCEPTION and exact_status INCONCLUSIVE; the following valid case still completes.
cases_and_expected_results.timeout: A worker and observed descendant sleeping past the external 0.5-second test budget are terminated; all captured PIDs are confirmed not running.
cases_and_expected_results.memory: A one-byte sampled RSS threshold triggers MEMORY_LIMIT_OBSERVED; it is explicitly a soft polling trigger, not a hard quota.
cases_and_expected_results.interruption: A completed first result remains PASS; the active and not-started cases remain INCONCLUSIVE after a stop event.
cases_and_expected_results.incomplete: A zero exit without a complete worker JSON is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
cases_and_expected_results.stop_file: Creating a stop file terminates the active process and leaves no active worker PID.

execution.test_invocation: One exact pytest nodeid per command; no directory, module, or suite target.
execution.process_termination: Windows taskkill /T /F followed by psutil confirmation; sampled process-tree RSS.
execution.output: Test-generated inputs and checkpoints are confined to pytest temporary directories.

interpretation: These tests validate bounded supervisor behavior on the tested Windows host only. RSS is sampled and may overshoot between samples; process termination is best effort. No platform-independent memory quota or numerical qualification is established.
historical_policy: The J19 exact checker and J14-J20 historical guard/results are not rewritten. No NAFEMS data or harmonic execution is used by this contract.
